headline:
Mortgage rates hit a
[[14-month high]].
The wait has a price.
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: A year of waiting for rates to drop just cost the average Broward buyer real money.
sources: Freddie Mac via Florida Realtors, Sept. 10, 2026

stats.label: The 30-year fixed rate climbed to 6.76% this week, the highest level in over 14 months.
That is roughly $100 more every month than a year ago on a typical $375,000 Broward mortgage.
Held for the full 30 years, that gap adds up to about $36,000 in extra interest.
